calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Stay Partners
calls.summary: The team seeks to improve their experimentation approach, currently limited to manual tests which capture only 10% of their targeted experimentation maturity. They aim to adopt GrowthBook’s full lifecycle experimentation platform, which integrates feature flagging and advanced analytics, supporting multiple brands and technologies. Key features include automated setup to increase efficiency, guardrail metrics with a kill switch to mitigate risks, and a pricing model that aligns with their expected experiment volume of 5 to 15 per month. The platform also supports a user-friendly visual editor to empower non-technical users, alongside secure data handling through a warehouse-native approach.
calls.keywords: AB testing, feature flagging, experimentation platform, open source, scalability, guardrail metrics
